prompt_leakage.finding: CogniCore's structured engine transmits unfiltered schema and semantic facts to the LLM during candidate SQL generation, leaking denied column names into 255 prompts.

result_cache.finding: No query-level result caching mechanism exists in CogniCore. Caching is limited to internal registry DB handles and LLM model instances; zero cross-user cache leakage observed.

conversation_memory.finding: buildConversationContext retrieves recent turns keyed purely by sessionId without inspecting userId or role permissions. If a session is shared or queried across role transitions, assistant responses containing restricted data from prior turns are injected into subsequent prompts.

quality_outlier_banners.finding: GET /api/analytics/:datasetId/quality explicitly invokes policyRestrictsAggregates() and returns 403 Forbidden for row-filtered roles, and filters out issue items referencing denied columns.

analytics_tools.finding: runSafeSql enforces AST validation and data policy. However, generateKpis() (kpi.js:28) executes calculation queries directly against raw adapters before memory-filtering in report builder, computing metrics on denied columns on the live database.

preview_and_schema_routes.finding: GET /api/datasets/:id/preview and GET /api/schema/:datasetId execute without policy enforcement, disclosing denied columns and restricted rows to any authenticated user with dataset read capability. /api/tools/export exports raw CSV/XLSX without PII masking.

error_messages.finding: PolicyError exception text explicitly echoes the denied column name ("Your role does not have access to the column 'bal'.").

pragma_introspection.finding: Queries like SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('t') pass AST safety validation and assertColumnAccess, revealing denied column names.
